_comment: Claude models offered in the ChatGPT desktop picker. claude_model is passed to `claude --model`: an alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) follows Claude Code to new releases, a full model id pins one version. efforts lists the reasoning levels the model accepts; an empty list means the model has no effort setting.

models.description: Latest Claude Opus through Claude Code. Most capable for long agentic work.
Latest Claude Sonnet through Claude Code. Fast and capable.
Latest Claude Haiku through Claude Code. Fastest, for simple tasks.
